system.description: A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic.
system.notes:
Normal | Skulk

A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic. Motives & Tactics: Evade, hide, pilfer, profit

Difficulty: 15 | Thresholds: 5/9 | HP: 4 | Stress: 5

ATK: +3 | Weapon: Melee | 1d6+2 physical

Experience: Acrobatics +3, Intrusion +3

Features

Quick Hands - Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+2 physical damage and the Thief steals one item or consumable from the target’s inventory.

Escape Plan - Action: Mark a Stress to enact an escape plan. All targets within Very Close range of the Thief must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll (13) or be taken by surprise. A surprised target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they gain their senses with a successful Wits (15) rolll.
